people.college: Bethel University; B.A. in Missional Ministries
people.calling: Vocational ministry was not on my mind going into college, and graduating with just a ministry degree was one thing I said I’d never do. It’s funny how God works like that. After an extended period of wrestling with the patient yet persistent voice of God, and by the faithful witness of those around me, I accepted God’s call on my life to pastoral ministry in the local church. I’m looking forward to growing in my understanding and confidence of the particular ways I have been gifted and burdened to cultivate people’s imaginations around knowing and following Jesus!
